title: Combination Sum
hints: Build a combination one number at a time and recurse with the remaining target. To avoid producing [2, 3] and [3, 2] separately, never go back to an earlier candidate.
Pass a start index: at each level loop over candidates[start:], and recurse with the same index (reuse allowed), not start + 1.
Sort the candidates and break out of the loop as soon as a candidate exceeds the remaining target; that prunes whole subtrees. Record path[:] when the remainder hits 0.
